episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on building a successful real estate business through YouTube without paid ads or cold calling. She emphasizes the importance of consistency, having backup resources, and maintaining a video bank to ensure uninterrupted content flow. Sarah provides actionable strategies for content planning and filming, highlighting the need for discipline over motivation.
